name: Shipshap
author: shipshap

sections.description:
The ShipShap WooCommerce plugin lets you easily connect your store to ShipShap’s powerful shipping and payment platform. Instantly access real-time shipping rates from multiple domestic and international carriers, generate labels, and streamline order fulfillment all within WooCommerce.

Key Features:

  • Live Shipping Rates – Access competitive rates from trusted carriers for both local and international deliveries.
  • Integrated Payment Collection – Accept secure payments via Credit Cards, M-Pesa, and more, powered by ShipShap.
  • Seamless WooCommerce Integration – Works directly within your store’s checkout and order flow.
  • Flexible Product Setup – Use SKUs or product IDs, and set default dimensions for faster rate calculations.

Requirements:

  • WooCommerce must be installed and active in your store.
  • A ShipShap account is required to unlock full functionality. Sign up here.

Terms & Policies:

  • ShipShap Terms of Service
  • ShipShap Privacy Policy

Third party services

This plugin interacts with the following third party services in order to provide its functionality:

  • ShipShap – Processes shipping rates, payments, and fulfillment requests.
    service URL: Shipshap (https://shipshap.com)
    description: Shipshap’s domain, to where the plugin user is expected to have an account to access the full functionality of the plugin
    terms of use: Shipshap Terms of Service (https://shipshap.com/terms)
    privacy policy: Shipshap Privacy Policy (https://shipshap.com/privacy)

  • Stripe – Handles secure credit card transactions in compliance with global security standards.
    service URL: Stripe (https://stripe.com)
    description: If the customer wants to allow the use of credit cards, Stripe is a provider that will allow the registration of cards while following good practices on credit card transmission on the web.
    terms of use: Stripe Terms of Service (https://stripe.com/legal)
    privacy policy: Stripe Privacy Policy (https://stripe.com/privacy)
sections.faq:
• Do I need SKUs for all products?
    No. SKUs are recommended for easier tracking, but product IDs will be used if SKUs are missing.

  • Do I need to set product dimensions?
    Not for every product you can set store-wide defaults. However, accurate dimensions are crucial for correct international shipping rates.

  • Where do I get my API tokens?
    Use Connect to ShipShap in WooCommerce → Settings → Shipshap, or enter keys manually under Advanced settings.

0.8.0

  • ShipShap dashboard connect flow
  • Settings UI — connection status, Connect/Reconnect button, manual API keys in collapsible Advanced section
  • Cache ShipShap read API responses (checkout config, user services, payment setup) to reduce duplicate requests
  • Checkout cart-totals AJAX recalculates deposits locally without refetching payment setup

0.7.1

  • added option in order details to retry a customer payment (if not successful)

0.7.0

  • added support for blocks checkout type alongside the classic shortcode

0.6.7

  • add minimum deposit amount so any amount_up_front that is under that amount will instead be charged the minimum deposit amount
  • bug fixes for payment on delivery selection

0.6.5

  • better flow for cancelled payments

0.6.4

  • bug fixes

0.6.0

  • expanded more configuration to the partial payments by allowing you to configure how much to colelct up front within payment settings. Previous settings relevant to shipping such as default weights and more have been added into the appropriate ShipShap Shipping methods pages (in WooCommerce > Settings > Shipping > ShipShap Shipping Methods).

0.5.0

  • added possibility to collect partial payment on order creation and collect rest on delivery (via ShipShap Deliveries)

0.4.0

  • added support for disabling or enabling payment methods (within WC payment settings for ShipShap)

  • critical fix for older php versions
